name: NeonSoup DEX Design System
tagline: Rebel kawaii cyberpunk execution for Cardano DeFi.
description: NeonSoup is a peer-to-peer Cardano DeFi execution layer. The design system blends cypherpunk self-sovereignty, soup-kitchen warmth, holomorphic HUD panels, and CyberNeko state helpers into a Bootstrap-friendly web UI language.

logo.notes: The NeonSoup pot icon is the primary brand image. Use it as route/product emphasis or a brand signal, not as the current no-silos quote-card breakout.

colors.name: background
colors.usage: Dark cyberpunk page background and scene overlay base.

colors.name: cyan rail
colors.usage: Structural rails, focus rings, secondary actions, and electric highlights.

colors.name: magenta action
colors.usage: Primary CTA color and restrained rebel glow.

colors.name: violet depth
colors.usage: Depth glows, HUD shadows, and dark-theme gradient support.

colors.name: border
colors.usage: Hairline card rails and control outlines.

colors.name: success
colors.usage: Valid route, confirmed wallet, and ready liquidity states.

colors.name: warning
colors.usage: Simulation warnings, testnet disclaimers, and attention states.

colors.name: danger
colors.usage: Blocked routes, rejected signatures, and high-risk states.

lightColors.name: light cyan rail
lightColors.usage: Light-theme rails, animation glows, focus rings, and secondary actions.

lightColors.name: light output green
lightColors.usage: Estimated served output, successful routes, and confirmed states in light mode.

lightColors.name: light info cyan
lightColors.usage: Light-theme scanning, route discovery, and protocol note states.

themes.dark: Cyberpunk street-food kitchen: dark violet/blue base, cyan rails, magenta action glow, legible glass panels.
themes.light: Solarpunk kitchen lab: vivid cyan/teal surfaces, bright output-green success states, violet copy, magenta action accents, lower glow density.

display.usage: Hero titles, manifesto headings, and loud rebel marks. Keep uppercase and tight.

body.usage: Body copy, navigation, controls, and card text.

mono.usage: Labels, protocol metadata, ticks, IDs, and status readouts.

voice.tone: Direct, cypherpunk, and welcoming. The copy should feel like an open kitchen for self-custody, not a corporate exchange.
messagingPillars: No silos, no middlemen, no exclusive frontends.
Open intents that become wallet-sealed transactions at the last mile.

imagery.style: Holomorphic cyberpunk soup-kitchen world with kawaii product helpers, neon rails, violet-blue depth, cyan/magenta highlights, and restrained texture.
subjects: wallet and route kitchen product modules
P2P soup separator pot-to-pot fluid flow
imagery.treatment: Use assets as intentional breakout layers or cropped hero/product moments. Never flood small text with full noisy images.

layout.radius: Cards use asymmetric 28px/16px/32px/14px posture; controls use 14px; pills use 999px.
layout.borderWeight: 1px cyan or magenta hairline rails with inner glows and interlaced texture.
layout.spacing: 8px baseline grid with extra top/right padding when mascot breakouts are present.
postureRules: Let mascot, kitchen, and icon art break out from cards without clipping.
Raise the parent card z-index when a breakout crosses sibling cards.
Keep text wide in manifesto and quote cards; use kitchen art as the current no-silos quote-card breakout.
Use punk-mark labels instead of holo-label pills.
Custom-style every dropdown; hide the native select but keep it synchronized for forms.
CyberNekos and kitchen utilities share one breakout styling treatment on content cards.
Reserve internal padding so breakout art never covers headline or body copy.

components.name: holomorphic card
components.notes: Interlaced texture, neon rails, clipped corner glints, readable glass.

components.name: punk mark
components.notes: Mono uppercase label with slashed cyan/magenta underline. Replaces the rejected holo-label pattern.

components.name: cyber select
components.notes: Styled dropdown shell for all select interactions.

components.name: mascot breakout
components.notes: CyberNeko and kitchen art is absolute, pointer-events none, z-index above sibling cards; parent gets enough padding and the same styling treatment.

components.name: quote breakout
components.notes: Full-width quote card with copy-first layout and kitchen artwork breaking out from the right edge.

components.name: p2p soup fluid separator
components.notes: Reusable scroll-linked pot-to-pot fluid catapult. Preserves interior-to-interior anchors, visible neon glows, bubbles, payload scaling, keyword-over-payload stacking, and mobile half-offscreen pots.
